issues.description: Method parameter list mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the template defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (an extra boolean parameter named 'validateInput'), whereas the problem statement (task description and UML) and the solution implementation define public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). This discrepancy forces students to implement a differently-signed method than the tests and UML expect and can cause compilation failures or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by changing the template method signature to the single-parameter form: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). If input validation is required for pedagogical reasons, implement validation inside that single-parameter method or add an overload (public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)) while keeping the required single-parameter method available so student code and tests compile against the expected signature.
